messages:
meera: ACME reported that when they asked for a $50 store credit our API created an account note instead. Ticket ACME-4821. Posting curl + payload I used to repro.

meera: (curl + body)
```
POST /v1/tools/call
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-infer-002\",
  \"input\": \"Customer requested $50 credit\",
  \"tools\": [\"apply_store_credit\", \"create_account_note\"],
  \"metadata\": {\"customer_id\":\"cust_793\", \"amount\":50}
}
```

taylor: Can you paste the model/tool_call the LLM returned? I want to see why the router accepted the note tool.

meera: Got it, LLM emitted: tool_call name=\"create_account_note\" args={\"customer_id\":\"cust_793\", \"note\":\"issued $50 credit (pending)\"}. Router accepted it and returned 200 with {\"status\":\"note_created\", \"id\":\"note_987\"}.

router-bot: decision_log call_id=call_20250304_23 -> scores: apply_store_credit=0.41, create_account_note=0.44. Chosen=create_account_note (tie-break: lower latency estimate). Reason: signature overlap (both accept customer_id + freeform string).

sophie: Root cause looks like signature ambiguity + fuzzy matcher bias. create_account_note currently accepts (customer_id, note) and apply_store_credit accepts (customer_id, amount), but the LLM formatted the amount as text in the note so fuzzy_signature matched note higher. We need stricter schemas and keyword bias for monetary intents.

meera: Repro steps that hit the bad path (100% reproducible locally):
1) POST payload above
2) Observe 200 + note_created result
3) If you explicitly set \"tool\":\"apply_store_credit\" in the body it applies the credit as expected. Example repro: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/call \
 -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
 -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-infer-002\",\"input\":\"apply $50 credit\",\"tool\":\"apply_store_credit\",\"metadata\":{\"customer_id\":\"cust_793\",\"amount\":50}}'
```

taylor: Sounds like we coerce numeric-looking tokens into freeform sometimes. Does schema validation allow an \"amount\" field on create_account_note?

router-bot: router config snippet:
```
- matcher: fuzzy_signature
  weight: 0.6
- matcher: latency_est
  weight: 0.3
- fallback: top_score
```

sophie: Proposed mitigation plan:
- short term: bump signature matcher weight and add keyword bias (if input contains [\$|credit|refund] then add +0.5 to tools in monetary namespace).
- medium term: tighten create_account_note signature to require \"note_text\" and explicitly forbid numeric-only \"amount\" fields.
- add regression test: sample prompt that previously routed to note must route to apply_store_credit.

meera: Customer impact: ACME didn't receive the credit; CS applied it manually and they're waiting for permanent fix. Ticket remains open for rollback/verif.

deploy-bot: Started deploy for router hotfix (canary) job=5532.

sophie: Canary (20m sample) shows no misroutes on sampled traffic. Rolling to 10% then 100% if stable. I pushed PR#4281 for the keyword bias and a temporary +0.5 override for apply_store_credit when currency tokens present.

meera: CS update sent to ACME, credit applied manually, customer content for now. Leaving ticket open until tests + signature change land.

taylor: Follow-ups: sophie -> own router rule hotfix & PR; eng-qa -> add regression test; meera -> verify and close when merged. Also please emit structured trace when chosen_tool != top_signature_match so ops can alert on future drift.

sophie: Adding a monitoring alert: if create_account_note usage spikes when prompts include currency tokens, trigger pager. Also adding the structured trace log change to the PR.

meera: Workaround: integrators can set explicit \"tool\" in the request to avoid autorouter ambiguity until the change is live. :thumbsup:
